description: This file contains unit tests for the Azure Table Storage reminder functionality in an Orleans-based application. It tests insert rate performance, row insertion, and data retrieval from the reminder table.

classes.name: ReminderTests_Azure_Standalone
classes.description: A test class for Azure Table Storage reminders, focusing on insert rate performance and reminder persistence.

methods.name: Reminders_AzureTable_InsertRate
methods.description: Tests the insertion rate of reminder entries into Azure Table Storage.

methods.name: Reminders_AzureTable_InsertNewRowAndReadBack
methods.description: Inserts a new reminder row and reads back to verify the data was stored correctly.

methods.name: TestTableInsertRate
methods.description: Conducts a performance test by inserting multiple reminder entries and measuring the rate.

methods.name: NewReminderEntry
methods.description: Creates a new sample ReminderEntry object with randomized data.

methods.name: NewClusterId
methods.description: Generates a new unique cluster ID string.

methods.name: GetAllRows
methods.description: Retrieves all reminder rows from the specified reminder table.
